937: 
938:     """
939:     validate(reference_labels, estimated_labels)
940:     ref_roots, ref_semitones = encode_many(reference_labels, False)[:2]
941:     est_roots, est_semitones = encode_many(estimated_labels, False)[:2]
942: 
943:     eq_roots = ref_roots == est_roots
944:     eq_semitones = np.all(np.equal(ref_semitones, est_semitones), axis=1)
945:     comparison_scores = (eq_roots * eq_semitones).astype(np.float64)
946: 
947:     # Ignore 'X' chords
948:     comparison_scores[np.any(ref_semitones < 0, axis=1)] = -1.0
949:     return comparison_scores
950: 
951: 
952: def tetrads_inv(reference_labels, estimated_labels):
953:     """Compare chords along tetrad (root, full quality, & bass) relationships.
954: 
955:     Examples
956:     --------
957:     >>> (ref_intervals,
958:     ...  ref_labels) = mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals('ref.lab')
959:     >>> (est_intervals,
960:     ...  est_labels) = mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals('est.lab')
961:     >>> est_intervals, est_labels = mir_eval.util.adjust_intervals(
962:     ...     est_intervals, est_labels, ref_intervals.min(),
963:     ...     ref_intervals.max(), mir_eval.chord.NO_CHORD,
964:     ...     mir_eval.chord.NO_CHORD)
965:     >>> (intervals,
966:     ...  ref_labels,
967:     ...  est_labels) = mir_eval.util.merge_labeled_intervals(
968:     ...      ref_intervals, ref_labels, est_intervals, est_labels)
969:     >>> durations = mir_eval.util.intervals_to_durations(intervals)
970:     >>> comparisons = mir_eval.chord.tetrads_inv(ref_labels, est_labels)
971:     >>> score = mir_eval.chord.weighted_accuracy(comparisons, durations)
972: 
973:     Parameters
974:     ----------
975:     reference_labels : list, len=n
976:         Reference chord labels to score against.
977:     estimated_labels : list, len=n
978:         Estimated chord labels to score against.
979: 
980:     Returns
981:     -------
982:     comparison_scores : np.ndarray, shape=(n,), dtype=float
983:         Comparison scores, in [0.0, 1.0]
984: 
985:     """
986:     validate(reference_labels, estimated_labels)
987:     ref_roots, ref_semitones, ref_bass = encode_many(reference_labels, False)
988:     est_roots, est_semitones, est_bass = encode_many(estimated_labels, False)
989: 
990:     eq_roots = ref_roots == est_roots
991:     eq_basses = ref_bass == est_bass
992:     eq_semitones = np.all(np.equal(ref_semitones, est_semitones), axis=1)
993:     comparison_scores = (eq_roots * eq_semitones * eq_basses).astype(np.float64)
994: 
995:     # Ignore 'X' chords
996:     comparison_scores[np.any(ref_semitones < 0, axis=1)] = -1.0
997:     return comparison_scores
998: 
999: 
1000: def root(reference_labels, estimated_labels):
1001:     """Compare chords according to roots.
1002: 
1003:     Examples
1004:     --------
1005:     >>> (ref_intervals,
1006:     ...  ref_labels) = mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals('ref.lab')
1007:     >>> (est_intervals,
1008:     ...  est_labels) = mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals('est.lab')
1009:     >>> est_intervals, est_labels = mir_eval.util.adjust_intervals(
1010:     ...     est_intervals, est_labels, ref_intervals.min(),
1011:     ...     ref_intervals.max(), mir_eval.chord.NO_CHORD,
1012:     ...     mir_eval.chord.NO_CHORD)
1013:     >>> (intervals,
1014:     ...  ref_labels,
1015:     ...  est_labels) = mir_eval.util.merge_labeled_intervals(
1016:     ...      ref_intervals, ref_labels, est_intervals, est_labels)
1017:     >>> durations = mir_eval.util.intervals_to_durations(intervals)
1018:     >>> comparisons = mir_eval.chord.root(ref_labels, est_labels)
1019:     >>> score = mir_eval.chord.weighted_accuracy(comparisons, durations)
1020: 
1021:     Parameters
1022:     ----------
1023:     reference_labels : list, len=n
1024:         Reference chord labels to score against.
1025:     estimated_labels : list, len=n
1026:         Estimated chord labels to score against.
1027: 
1028:     Returns
1029:     -------
1030:     comparison_scores : np.ndarray, shape=(n,), dtype=float
1031:         Comparison scores, in [0.0, 1.0], or -1 if the comparison is out of
1032:         gamut.
1033:     """
1034:     validate(reference_labels, estimated_labels)
1035:     ref_roots, ref_semitones = encode_many(reference_labels, False)[:2]
1036:     est_roots = encode_many(estimated_labels, False)[0]
1037:     comparison_scores = (ref_roots == est_roots).astype(np.float64)
1038: 
1039:     # Ignore 'X' chords
1040:     comparison_scores[np.any(ref_semitones < 0, axis=1)] = -1.0
1041:     return comparison_scores
1042: 
1043: 
1044: def mirex(reference_labels, estimated_labels):
1045:     """Compare chords along MIREX rules.
1046: 
1047:     Examples
1048:     --------
1049:     >>> (ref_intervals,
1050:     ...  ref_labels) = mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals('ref.lab')
1051:     >>> (est_intervals,
1052:     ...  est_labels) = mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals('est.lab')
1053:     >>> est_intervals, est_labels = mir_eval.util.adjust_intervals(
1054:     ...     est_intervals, est_labels, ref_intervals.min(),
1055:     ...     ref_intervals.max(), mir_eval.chord.NO_CHORD,
1056:     ...     mir_eval.chord.NO_CHORD)
1057:     >>> (intervals,
1058:     ...  ref_labels,
1059:     ...  est_labels) = mir_eval.util.merge_labeled_intervals(
1060:     ...      ref_intervals, ref_labels, est_intervals, est_labels)
1061:     >>> durations = mir_eval.util.intervals_to_durations(intervals)
1062:     >>> comparisons = mir_eval.chord.mirex(ref_labels, est_labels)
1063:     >>> score = mir_eval.chord.weighted_accuracy(comparisons, durations)
1064: 
1065:     Parameters
1066:     ----------
1067:     reference_labels : list, len=n
1068:         Reference chord labels to score against.
1069:     estimated_labels : list, len=n
1070:         Estimated chord labels to score against.
1071: 
1072:     Returns
1073:     -------
1074:     comparison_scores : np.ndarray, shape=(n,), dtype=float
1075:         Comparison scores, in [0.0, 1.0]
1076: 
1077:     """
1078:     validate(reference_labels, estimated_labels)
1079:     # TODO(?): Should this be an argument?
1080:     min_intersection = 3
1081:     ref_data = encode_many(reference_labels, False)
1082:     ref_chroma = rotate_bitmaps_to_roots(ref_data[1], ref_data[0])
1083:     est_data = encode_many(estimated_labels, False)
1084:     est_chroma = rotate_bitmaps_to_roots(est_data[1], est_data[0])
1085: 
1086:     eq_chroma = (ref_chroma * est_chroma).sum(axis=-1)
1087: 
1088:     # Chroma matching for set bits
1089:     comparison_scores = (eq_chroma >= min_intersection).astype(np.float64)
1090: 
1091:     # No-chord matching; match -1 roots, SKIP_CHORDS dropped next
1092:     no_root = np.logical_and(ref_data[0] == -1, est_data[0] == -1)
